The analysis failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in panel margins and total annual margin calculations.
The run failed with an AssertionError in test_rows_and_order and test_totals_and_decision within /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the calculated panel margin was 369.2 vs an expected 6276.4, and the total annual margin for the 14-day panel was 26185.96 vs an expected 1090.76. Avoid incorrect scaling or aggregation logic in the cost-benefit calculation, as the verifier returned a reward of 0.00 despite the code executing without exceptions.
